name: One overnight full-network min-max gradient-consistency trial

attack.threat_model: single-class clean-label targeted poisoning; fixed standard-attack poisons

defense.precision: FP32 inputs, weights, CE and penalties; TF32 enabled in both conditions
defense.norm: Sum of squared gradient differences over ALL 11,173,962 trainable parameters, including convolution/classifier weights, biases and BN affine parameters. Uniformly sample 8 examples without replacement from each 128-image batch, average their exact full-network per-example penalties. No parameter sampling or parameter-count normalization.
defense.estimator: Monte Carlo estimate of the minibatch's per-example approximate-max penalty. All 128 images contribute to classification at every step. The 8-image sample is redrawn on every update using only the separate defense RNG. For a fixed independently sampled perturbation random start per example, uniform image sampling is unbiased for that batch average; it increases estimator variance and does not reproduce full-128-image penalty updates.
defense.inner: Feasible uniform pixel-space random start, three projected sign-ascent steps, retain best per-example point across the trajectory; approximate local maximization, not a global guarantee.
defense.outer: CE on all 128 original augmented images plus lambda times the mean sampled-image squared full-network gradient difference. Freeze selected perturbations during the outer update; differentiate through both gradient branches.
defense.batchnorm: CE uses training statistics and updates buffers once. Both gradient-penalty branches and all ascent steps use fixed BN running statistics and disabled dropout. BN affine parameters remain differentiable and included.

selection: One predeclared target/poison case and one independent victim seed; retain the trial irrespective of attack success. No target or lambda sweep.
matched: Identical saved poisons, initialization seed, batch order and spatial augmentation draws between the undefended and defended victims. Separate defense RNG.
evaluation: One matched targeted-poisoning trial on the paper's full CIFAR10/CIFAR-adapted ResNet18 setup, with an explicitly sampled full-network per-example min-max defense; fixed standard-attack poisons, not adaptive poisoning.
inference: Feasibility/proof-of-concept only. Report the two raw target predictions, accuracy, penalty/ascent diagnostics, time and memory. One trial cannot estimate a general attack success rate or establish defense robustness.
uncertainty: One target/seed pair; no aggregate success-rate estimate, error bars or significance claim. A failed optimizer is not a successfully prevented attack.
failure_policy: No automatic lambda change, layer restriction, epoch reduction, outer gradient clipping, or extra attack trials. Nonfinite optimization is recorded as a failure. Stop and checkpoint before the hard morning deadline even if incomplete; do not automatically continue beyond it.
